question: What is the meaning of reused parts in relation to product information?
description:
Reused parts refer to components or materials that have been previously used in another product and are incorporated into a new product. In the context of product information, statements about reused parts provide details on the presence of such parts, their mass fraction in relation to the total product mass, and public availability of this data. This information is crucial for assessing the sustainability and resource efficiency of the product. <|ENDINPUT>
